column1: # Black/Matrix AD - Chapter 4: Moze Invites the Party to Noah
# No manual wrapping: patchline.py supplies pixel-aware line breaks.

column2: The rational judgment that cannot be swayed by the illusions I created or by sophistry—that is precisely
proof that you are the $$救世主$$, apostle of this $$世界$$'s $$大善神$$, $$ハ・サタン$$!!
I shall offer all my knowledge, all of myself, to you.
To the Land of Enslavement, $$ノア$$!!
I sort of understand what you're trying to say...
But according to that old man's argument...
our hands are already utterly stained with dark $$血$$...
So even if the daughters of the bereaved families there were real,
unless we can make the cool-headed decision to kill them anyway...
it would not prove that he is the $$救世主$$, would it!
